findings.text: Every test passes --target tmp_path/skills, so the AC-stated default destination (TARGET="$HOME/.gemini/config/skills" in the .sh, Join-Path $baseHome ".gemini\config\skills" in the .ps1) is never asserted; changing the default to ~/.gemini/antigravity/skills (the bug being bridged) would leave all tests green.

findings.ac: AC3 Antigravity IDE discovers all copied skills
findings.text: No test, doc text or recorded manual check covers discovery via the Antigravity skill listing; the tests only check files exist under --target (SKILL.md and references/) and never run against ~/.gemini/config or an Antigravity listing.

test_copies_every_skill_with_references compares dest to whatever dist/skills currently contains (_bundle_skills) rather than asserting 26, and skips if dist/skills is unbuilt, so a build that drops skills still passes.

test_creates_no_symlinks only checks the output of a bundle that contains no symlinks (find dist/skills -type l is empty); no source symlink/junction is planted, so cp -r / Copy-Item preserving a link would not be exercised.

findings.ac: Overview / design Track D optional plugin manifest
findings.text: Issue Mental Model and design Track D mention an optional plugin manifest to ~/.gemini/config/plugins/stratosphere-os; neither script implements it and no test or text states it was deliberately dropped.
